process_area.title: Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics

value_stream.name: Employee Transport, Shuttle & Daily Commute Management

fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100.3), Insurance (VS-26), HSE (VS-24), Finance (VS-17.4), Contingent Workforce (VS-98)
fields.Trigger: Operating model (W4244) selecting contracted service; vendor-market review; expansion

Automation Opportunity: - Vendor qualification checklist with document expiry tracking; e-sourcing; contract repository
Controls: - CTL-655 (ensure controlled execution — Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics (PA-141.3).)
- CTL-655: vendor LTFRB-franchised & insured (VS-26); HSE/DOLE record checked; contract Legal-reviewed (VS-100.3)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-03 (vendor master), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-26 (insurance), VS-24 (HSE), VS-98 (contingent drivers), W4258 (SLA)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unqualified-carrier risk**: Vendor without franchise/insurance → impound/liability; mitigated by qualification gate (LTFRB/insurance)
- **Co-employment risk**: Embedded drivers misclassified; mitigated by VS-98 guardrails
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/sourcing (VS-34); vendor master (VS-03); legal/contract (VS-100.3); insurance (VS-26); HSE (VS-24); contingent workforce (VS-98)
Time Estimate: - ~4–6 weeks per sourcing cycle; onboarding ~1–2 weeks/vendor

steps.activity: Procurement/Transport run a sourcing event (RFP/RFQ) for shuttle/charter vendors per region, defining service specs (routes, shifts, vehicle standard, driver standard, safety/insurance)
Procurement/Legal/HSE qualify bidders (LTFRB franchise, LTO-registered vehicles, driver licensing/clearance, passenger-liability insurance, HSE/DOLE record, financial standing)

Procurement/Legal negotiate and execute the master service agreement (rates, SLA, insurance indemnity, termination), onboard the vendor (coordinate VS-98 for embedded drivers), and load to vendor master (VS-03)

fields.Trigger: Contract start (W4257); monthly QBR; SLA breach
fields.Volume: SLA performance per vendor × route × month

workflows.name: Transport Vendor SLA, Performance & Rate Management

Automation Opportunity: - Auto SLA computation from GPS/dispatch data; vendor scorecard dashboard; penalty auto-trigger
Controls: - CTL-655 (ensure controlled execution — Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics (PA-141.3).)
- CTL-655: SLA tracked & enforced; rate changes governed/justified; underperformance acted on
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-67 (scorecard), VS-03 (vendor), VS-24 (HSE), VS-17.4 (finance), W4250 (data), W4259 (invoice)
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA-drift risk**: Late pickups unchecked → attendance impact; mitigated by on-time SLA tracking + penalties
- **Cost-creep risk**: Fuel-index/auto rate hikes unmanaged; mitigated by rate governance + benchmarking
System Touchpoints: - Dispatch/ridership (W4250); vendor scorecard (VS-67); procurement/contract (VS-34); HSE (VS-24); finance (VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Transport define and track the SLA (on-time pickup/arrival, vehicle/driver standard adherence, safety incidents, no-show response time, complaint resolution), and capture data from dispatch (W4250)
Transport/Procurement run the monthly/quarterly business review with vendors (performance scorecard, breach penalties/incentives, capacity changes), and manage rate changes (fuel-index clauses)
Transport manage corrective action/penalty enforcement, vendor development, and exit/replacement on sustained underperformance (coordinate VS-03/VS-34)

fields.Volume: Invoices per vendor (per-trip or monthly charter billing)

Automation Opportunity: - Manifest→invoice auto-match; penalty auto-deduction; 3-way-style reconciliation; BIR-invoice validation
Controls: - CTL-655: invoice matched to manifest/rate before payment; penalties applied; BIR-compliant invoice retained (VS-79)
Cross-references: - links to VS-15 (P2P/AP), VS-17.1 (GL), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-34 (contract/rate), VS-79 (BIR), W4250 (manifest), W4258 (penalties), W4246 (allocation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-billing risk**: Invoiced trips not run; mitigated by manifest-vs-invoice match before payment
- **Tax-compliance risk**: Non-BIR-compliant vendor invoices → disallowed expense; mitigated by OR/invoice validation (VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - AP/P2P (VS-15); GL/allocation (VS-17.1/W4246); contract/rate (VS-34); manifest (W4250); BIR invoicing (VS-79)

steps.activity: AP/Transport receive the vendor invoice (per-trip manifest count or fixed monthly charter), match to contracted rates (W4257) and actual trip/ridership records (W4250)
AP/Finance reconcile discrepancies (unrun trips, SLA penalties W4258, fuel-index adjustments), apply holdback/penalties, and resolve with the vendor
AP process payment per terms (VS-15 P2P), post to GL/allocation (W4246), and retain audit evidence (BIR-compliant OR/invoice per VS-79)

fields.Volume: Vehicles, drivers, and vendor crews across the network

workflows.name: Transport Compliance Audit, Vehicle Inspection & Insurance/License Registry

Automation Opportunity: - Document-expiry registry with auto-alerts/stop-service gating; digital inspection checklist; audit-finding → CAPA workflow
Controls: - CTL-655: registration/franchise/insurance/driver-license current; out-of-service enforced on lapse; audit CAPA tracked (VS-24/VS-133)
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-24 (HSE/CAPA), VS-06/VS-35 (fleet/asset), VS-26 (insurance), VS-88 (records), W4247 (framework), W4252 (pre-trip), W4255 (incident)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lapse risk**: Expired registration/insurance/license → impound/fine/uninsured loss; mitigated by expiry registry + out-of-service gate
- **Audit-failure risk**: Unfixed defects; mitigated by periodic audit + corrective action

steps.activity: Transport/Fleet maintain the compliance registry (vehicle LTO registration/inspection, franchise, insurance policy/passenger liability, driver license/clearance/medical — own + vendor), with expiry tracking and renewal alerts
HSE/Compliance run periodic on-ground audits (vehicle condition, pre-trip W4252 adherence, no-overload, seat-belt, HSE standard W4254), document findings, and require corrective action
Transport/Insurance/Legal enforce out-of-service for non-compliant vehicles/drivers (no service until cured), renew lapsed documents, and log to audit/records (VS-88/VS-24)

fields.Trigger: Monthly close (VS-17.1); annual budget (VS-33.1); cost-out program
fields.Volume: Transport cost data across 205 sites × modes

Automation Opportunity: - Consolidated cost dashboards; cost-per-trip auto-computation; scenario/analytics models
Controls: - CTL-655 (ensure controlled execution — Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics (PA-141.3).)
- CTL-655: cost consolidated & allocated (W4246); cost-out quantified; safety/EX impact jointly reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4/VS-28 (analytics), VS-61/VS-06 (fleet TCO), VS-34 (procurement), W4244/W4245/W4246 (model/budget), W4264 (review)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-blindness risk**: Modes costed in fragments; mitigated by consolidated total-cost-of-commute view
- **False-economy risk**: Cost-cut that harms safety/EX; mitigated by joint cost+EX+safety review (W4262/W4264)

steps.activity: Analytics/Finance assemble the total-cost-of-commute (owned-fleet opex VS-06/VS-61, vendor charter, allowance W4253, fuel, insurance, management overhead) per site/mode/employee
Analytics benchmark cost-per-employee-trip and cost-per-site vs peers/model (W4244), identify cost-out levers (route consolidation, allowance-vs-shuttle, rideshare), and quantify impact
Finance/Transport pursue cost-out (renegotiate W4258, resize fleet W4245, switch modes W4244), track realized savings, and re-baseline the budget

fields.Volume: Ridership × attendance × attrition data across the workforce

Automation Opportunity: - Ridership×attendance×attrition correlation models; at-risk auto-flagging; privacy-preserving aggregation
Controls: - CTL-655 (ensure controlled execution — Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics (PA-141.3).)
- CTL-655: home-location data handled per RA 10173 (VS-91); analytics aggregated; findings acted on & tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-103.3 (people analytics), VS-19.3/VS-19.1 (attendance/attrition), VS-28 (analytics), VS-91 (privacy), W4250 (ridership), W4248 (EX), W4264 (reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-cost risk**: Commute-driven attrition/absence unmeasured → under-investment; mitigated by correlation analytics
- **Privacy risk**: Home-location data misuse; mitigated by RA 10173 handling (VS-91) and aggregation
System Touchpoints: - People analytics (VS-103.3); ridership (W4250); time/attendance (VS-19.3); HRIS/attrition (VS-19.1); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: People Analytics join ridership (W4250) with attendance/time (VS-19.3) and attrition (VS-19.1) to test correlation (poor commute → absenteeism/lateness/turnover), by site/shift
Analytics identify at-risk sites/shifts/cohorts (e.g., long-commute new hires with elevated early attrition) and quantify the retention/payback case for transport investment
HR/Transport act on findings (extend coverage W4254, redesign routes W4263, targeted retention), track outcome, and feed EX (W4248) and reporting (W4264)

Automation Opportunity: - Route-utilization analytics; optimization/clustering tools; change-impact simulation
Controls: - CTL-655 (ensure controlled execution — Transport Vendor, Safety, Cost & Commute Analytics (PA-141.3).)
- CTL-655: changes piloted & validated (safety/EX); KPI-balanced; standard-work locked (VS-133)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-133 (OpEx/CI), VS-06 (route), VS-24 (HSE), VS-103.2 (EX), W4250 (ridership), W4261/W4262 (analytics), W4256 (feedback)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Disruption risk**: Route change strands staff; mitigated by pilot + safety/EX validation + comms
- **Sub-optimization risk**: Cost cut harms service; mitigated by joint cost+safety+EX KPI balancing
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (VS-28); OpEx/process mining (VS-133); dispatch/route (VS-06/W4250); HSE (VS-24); EX (VS-103.2)

steps.activity: Analytics/OpEx identify optimization candidates (low-utilization routes, long detours, mis-timed schedules, over/under-capacity) from ridership (W4250) and cost (W4261) data
Transport/Analytics redesign and pilot changes (route/stop/timing/capacity/mode), assess safety (W4254) and EX (W4248) impact, and validate before full rollout
Transport/OpEx deploy, monitor KPIs, and lock the improvement into standard work/CI backlog (VS-133), closing the loop with helpdesk feedback (W4256)

fields.Volume: One transport program scorecard for leadership

Automation Opportunity: - Balanced-scorecard dashboard; auto KPI rollup; audit-evidence pack generation
Controls: - CTL-655: balanced scorecard (cost/safety/EX/compliance); controls audit-assured (VS-21); feeds strategy/budget (VS-33)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-17.4/VS-33 (finance/strategy), VS-24 (HSE), VS-21 (audit), W4241/W4246 (strategy/budget), W4250/W4255/W4258/W4261/W4262 (KPI inputs)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Blind-spot risk**: Single KPI over-optimized (e.g., cost over safety); mitigated by balanced scorecard
- **Assurance risk**: Controls unverified; mitigated by internal-audit review (VS-21)

steps.activity: Transport/Analytics assemble the program scorecard (cost-per-employee W4261, on-time SLA W4258, safety incidents W4255, ridership/utilization W4250, commute-EX W4248, attrition correlation W4262)
Transport present the review to leadership (COO/CHRO/CFO), flag risks (safety, cost, EX, compliance W4260), and secure decisions/investment
Transport/Internal Audit verify program controls (allowance entitlement, vendor invoice, compliance registry), report assurance (VS-21), and feed the strategy/budget cycle (W4241/W4246/VS-33)
